build_AicDataset: build a python module to instantiate AicDataset for AI Challenger pose estimation with 14 keypoints
create_AicDataset_topdown: create an AicDataset instance in topdown mode for single instance pose estimation samples
test_AicDataset_bottomup: test the AicDataset in bottomup mode to load all instances per image
review_AicDataset_metainfo: review the AicDataset METAINFO config file path for dataset keypoint definitions
summarize_AicDataset: summarize the AicDataset class which extends BaseCocoStyleDataset for COCO-style pose data
